title: Minimum Size & Clearspace
slide_intent: Protect legibility by specifying both the smallest usable mark and the space it needs around it.
strategic_value: A common rule can help the lockup survive scale changes and avoid crowding.
demonstration: Two small logo specimens specify 14 px on screen and 0.25 in in print. A larger diagram repeats the width of the letter c around the signature.
practical_value: Check the minimum size for the output medium and reserve the indicated c-based clearance on every side.
